thesis: The speakers argue that every company is becoming an API company, creating a universal need for robust API platforms that provide SDKs, documentation, and versioning to allow developers to focus on core capabilities. They further discuss how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) reframes APIs as interfaces for AI agents, introducing new design challenges where the goal is to make APIs idiomatic and ergonomic for large language models rather than just human developers.
